scope: staging-only M4 artifact package and disposable Arch ARM hook check
contents: Nested kernel, loader and Mesa packages, generic default and fallback initramfs, unsigned stage one, sample stage two, Omarchy boot source, and offline recovery and Gravity installer adaptation tools are files under /usr/share/omarchy-m4-research/bundle. No nested package is installed by this package.
build_environment: Local Ubuntu ARM64 VM using makepkg; no dependency resolution for this file-only package
check: Release 9 was built locally with makepkg and source checksum verification. The earlier release 5 passed a fresh-install pacman transaction in a disposable Arch ARM overlay with dependency checks disabled; its recording updater was not invoked. Release 9 has not had a separate transaction check.
limitations: only a fresh staging transaction was checked
no production dependency resolution, future hooks or Gravity-side updater protection
staging does not activate the kernel or prepare a qualified recovery
no M4 hardware or HDMI validation
